from azure.cosmos import CosmosClient, PartitionKey

def upsert_document(database_name, container_name, document):
    client = CosmosClient('https://<your-cosmosdb-instance>.documents.azure.com:443/', credential='<your-cosmosdb-key>')
    database = client.get_database_client(database_name)
    container = database.get_container_client(container_name)
    container.upsert_item(document)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    upsert_document('myDatabase', 'myContainer', {'id': '123', 'name': 'John Doe'})

from azure.cosmos import CosmosClient, PartitionKey

def fetch_document(database_name, container_name, document_id):
    client = CosmosClient('https://<your-cosmosdb-instance>.documents.azure.com:443/', credential='<your-cosmosdb-key>')
    database = client.get_database_client(database_name)
    container = database.get_container_client(container_name)
    document = container.read_item(document_id, partition_key=PartitionKey(document_id))
    return document

if __name__ == '__main__':
    print(fetch_document('myDatabase', 'myContainer', '123'))

from azure.cosmos import CosmosClient, PartitionKey

def query_documents(database_name, container_name, query):
    client = CosmosClient('https://<your-cosmosdb-instance>.documents.azure.com:443/', credential='<your-cosmosdb-key>')
    database = client.get_database_client(database_name)
    container = database.get_container_client(container_name)
    documents = list(container.query_items(
        query=query,
        enable_cross_partition_query=True))
    return documents

if __name__ == '__main__':
    print(query_documents('myDatabase', 'myContainer', 'SELECT * FROM c WHERE c.name = '))

from azure.cosmos import CosmosClient, PartitionKey

def conditional_update(database_name, container_name, document_id, update_operations):
    client = CosmosClient('https://<your-cosmosdb-instance>.documents.azure.com:443/', credential='<your-cosmosdb-key>')
    database = client.get_database_client(database_name)
    container = database.get_container_client(container_name)
    document = container.read_item(document_id, partition_key=PartitionKey(document_id))
    document.update(update_operations)
    container.upsert_item(document)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    conditional_update('myDatabase', 'myContainer', '123', {'name': 'Jane Doe'})

from google.cloud import translate_v2 as translate

def translate_text(text, target_language):
    client = translate.Client()
    result = client.translate(text, target_language=target_language)
    return result['translatedText']

if __name__ == '__main__':
    print(translate_text('Hello World!', 'es'))
